name: unigrid.css
description: A CSS grid framework inspired by Massimo Vignelli's Unigrid system for the National Park Service

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: sass src/scss/unigrid.scss dist/unigrid.css --style=expanded && sass src/scss/unigrid.scss dist/unigrid.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.watch: npm run watch:css & npm run watch:js
